name: pricing-grow-business
blurb: Animated timeline component that sequences child animations on scroll into view.
description: TimelineAnimation component using motion and useInView to animate children in sequence with blur-in effect. Supports custom animation timing, customVariants, and once-per-scroll triggering.
use_when: You need to animate a sequence of content blocks as they enter the viewport.
avoid_when: For always-visible content; this is for scroll-triggered animations.
a11y: Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion via motion library. Content remains accessible without animation.
